title: Scalable High-Fidelity Macromolecular Docking for GPU-Accelerated Supercomputers
abstract: arXiv:2608.07078v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Flexible macromolecular docking offers high-fidelity predictions of biomolecular interactions, but remains prohibitively expensive at scale. Among existing approaches, LightDock leverages Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) for accuracy, yet suffers from limited parallelism, irregular computation, and severe load imbalance, preventing efficient execution on GPU supercomputers. We present SparkleDock, a scalable GSO-based docking framework enabling near-real-time flexible docking. We redesign GSO to expose massive fine-grained parallelism at the glowworm-agent level, and restructure the dominant energy scoring computation into a Tensor Core-compatible formulation, enabling efficient execution of irregular pairwise interactions through structured matrix operations. We further introduce a performance-model-driven scheduling for load balancing and out-of-core scaling across GPUs. SparkleDock achieves 9.7 $\times$ and 18.9 $\times$ sp

translated_title: 面向GPU加速超级计算机的可扩展高保真大分子对接
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07078v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：柔性大分子对接能够提供生物分子相互作用的高保真预测，但在大规模应用中仍成本过高。在现有方法中，LightDock利用萤火虫群优化（GSO）提高准确性，但受限于并行性不足、计算不规则和严重的负载不均衡，无法在GPU超级计算机上高效运行。我们提出了SparkleDock，一个基于GSO的可扩展对接框架，能够实现近实时柔性对接。我们重新设计了GSO，在萤火虫代理级别暴露大规模细粒度并行性，并将主导的能量评分计算重构为兼容张量核心的公式，通过结构化矩阵操作实现不规则成对交互的高效执行。我们还引入了基于性能模型的调度，用于跨GPU的负载均衡和超核扩展。SparkleDock实现了9.7倍和18.9倍的加速。
tldr: SparkleDock通过重新设计萤火虫群优化算法并利用张量核心兼容计算，实现了GPU超级计算机上近实时的可扩展高保真柔性大分子对接，显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: SparkleDock achieves near-real-time scalable high-fidelity flexible macromolecular docking on GPU supercomputers by redesigning Glowworm Swarm Optimization and leveraging Tensor Core-compatible computation, delivering significant speedups.
